The user wants the new color. We can compute the average of the RGB values: #FAEBD7 is (250, 235, 215). #00FFFF is (0, 255, 255). Average: ((250+0)/2=125), ((235+255)/2=245), ((215+255)/2=235). So new color is (125, 245, 235). Convert to hex: 125 decimal is 7D hex. 245 decimal is F5 hex. 235 decimal is EB hex. So #7DF5EB. That is a light teal-ish color. So we can answer directly.
